{{Season|Winter}} with [[Rain Totem]] |weather = Rain |difficulty = 40 |behavior = Mixed |size = 8-26 |price = 50 |edibility = 10 |roe = Red }} The '''Red Snapper''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] and on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Summer]] and [[Fall]] during [[Weather|rainy]] weather. It can also be caught during [[Winter]] if a [[Rain Totem]] is used. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during [[Summer]], [[Fall]], or [[Winter]], or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|50}}. Red Snapper can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Red Snapper can be found in the ocean. {{Map|275|200}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== Red Snapper is used in the {{Bundle|Ocean Fish||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Red Snapper can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. It also can be used as a red dye in the [[Sewing Machine]] or [[Dyeing|Dye Pots]], which can be found in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Red Snappers can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is red-colored Red Snapper [[Roe]].
